title: Fix : Sugar Calendar issues and broken pages
body: ### Issues - #31 - #34 - #36 - #37 - #40 ### Fixes proposed - [#31](https://github.com/OpenSourceOrg/dotOrg/issues/31) : Events on the event's archive page will cover `100%` of the width resolving the overlapping issue - [#34](https://github.com/OpenSourceOrg/dotOrg/issues/34) : Implemented a fix for the `Google Calendar` invite. When the event is added to the `Google Calendar`, the description ( post content ) will be prepended by the `URL`. - There is no particular setting I encountered for setting a meeting link for google events. - Regarding the URL for the `.ics` file that is downloaded, the location field is generally used for attaching the meeting link. - Resource I found: https://stackoverflow.com/a/64639563 - [#36](https://github.com/OpenSourceOrg/dotOrg/issues/36) : Weird characters show (in my case) due to setting the ticket price as `0` instead of `0.0`. When the ticket price is `0.0`, replace `$0.0 Per Ticket` with `Free Event` and also replace the button text with `Register` - [#37](https://github.com/OpenSourceOrg/dotOrg/issues/37) : The `upcoming events` will be shown by default on the archive page of the events, in ascending order of event dates. - [#40](https://github.com/OpenSourceOrg/dotOrg/issues/40) : Switched the `grid-template-columns` value for smaller viewports from `1fr` to `100%` and reduced padding for the `Add to Calendar` dropdown. ### Preview | Events Overlapping | Free Events | | --- | --- | | | | | Default Archive Order | Calendar Page (Mobile) | | --- | --- | | | |

title: OpenSource.org | Replace columned layout with a gallery
body:
OpenSource would like to replace the current column-based system of managing and adding sponsor logos on https://opensource.org/sponsors with something easier to manage.

We've suggested a gallery instead, making their life a bit easier.

I've added an initial exploration of the idea to [this copy post](https://opensource.org/wp-admin/post.php?post=6678&action=edit), using a regular Gutenberg gallery block, and would like to add a few more features to make it more usable:

- Linking from an image to the sponsor's site (we can use a caption or description filed for this)
- Images not spreading over more than 1 column (added as a togglable option)
- Ideally, a "Sort Alphabetically" option in the Edit Gallery screen that uses the Image Title

[Zendesk reference](https://woothemes.zendesk.com/agent/tickets/6286485)

title: Strange URL redirections
body:
Some of the old license URLs redirect to pages I do not expect. Since many open source projects link directly to the license pages on the OSI website, these URLs should either not change or should redirect properly to the expected licenses.

| License | Old URL | Redirects to |
| ------- | ------- | ------------ |
| AGPL-3.0 | https://opensource.org/licenses/AGPL-3.0 | `404` |
| Apache-2.0 | https://opensource.org/licenses/Apache-2.0 | `404` |
| BSD-1-Clause | https://opensource.org/licenses/BSD-1-Clause | https://opensource.org/license/bsd-1-clause-2/ (content is correct, but URL seems strange) |
| BSD-2-Clause | https://opensource.org/licenses/BSD-2-Clause | `404` (reported in #1) |
| MIT | https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT | https://opensource.org/license/mit-0/ |
| PHP-3.0 | https://opensource.org/licenses/PHP-3.0 | https://opensource.org/license/php-3-01/ (this is not the same license) |

And, oddly, this new URL: <https://opensource.org/license/mit/> \
Redirects to: <https://opensource.org/license/mit-license-php/>

I only did a spot-check of the licenses listed here, so this may not be representative of all problems with license URLs: <https://web.archive.org/web/20230121140616/https://opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical>
